name: io.github.JulienRabault/icloud-mcp
title: iCloud Mail
description: Read, search, draft, send and file iCloud Mail over IMAP and SMTP. No tool destroys mail.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your iCloud address, for example you@icloud.com.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: An app-specific password generated at account.apple.com. iCloud rejects your main password over IMAP.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_DISPLAY_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name shown in the From header of sent mail. Defaults to the local part of the address.
